categories.main_business_segments: Nantong Guosheng Intelligence Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: CNC machine tools, intelligent automated production lines, and equipment components. The CNC machine tools segment includes high-precision, high-speed, and high-efficiency metal cutting machines such as five-axis linkage vertical machining centers, gantry machining centers, and composite machining centers. The intelligent automated production lines segment provides integrated solutions including CNC machine tools and robotic automation for industries like automotive, semiconductor, and engine manufacturing. The equipment components segment focuses on manufacturing precision sheet metal parts, castings, and core functional components for intelligent manufacturing equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced technologies in error control, reliability, high-performance equipment components, composite processing, and secondary development and optimization. It has developed proprietary technologies for geometric and thermal error compensation, automatic online detection, and high-precision components such as five-axis cradle rotary tables and spindle units. Production methods include modular design, integrated system development, and in-house manufacturing of key components to ensure high precision and stability. The company also employs intelligent manufacturing processes, including automated welding and assembly lines, and advanced casting and sheet metal fabrication techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse range of industries including downstream mechanical equipment, precision molds, automotive, construction machinery, industrial valves, new energy, rail transit, civil aviation, petrochemical, wind power, semiconductor, and shipbuilding. Its key customers are large-scale manufacturers and industry-leading enterprises requiring high-end CNC machining and intelligent automation solutions. The company has expanded its customer base domestically and internationally, with increasing orders from benchmark clients in mold, semiconductor, and civil aviation sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Nantong, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its overseas market presence through participation in international exhibitions and establishing overseas sales channels. The company exports products and components to foreign markets, although domestic sales constitute the majority of revenue. It also maintains subsidiaries and joint ventures within China to support its manufacturing and R&D activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nantong Guosheng operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures CNC machine tools and intelligent automation production lines, integrating upstream components such as precision castings and sheet metal parts, many of which are produced in-house. The company also provides system integration, installation, and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in intelligent manufacturing equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment focusing on high-speed, high-rigidity, high-precision, and high-efficiency CNC machine tools, especially five-axis and composite machining centers. It aims to achieve import substitution by developing core functional components like five-axis rotary tables and spindles. R&D efforts also target intelligent automation solutions tailored to customer-specific applications in emerging industries such as semiconductors, new energy vehicles, and aerospace. The company fosters innovation in error compensation, thermal stability, and software-human interface optimization, supported by multiple patents and technology certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of CNC machine tools, intelligent automated production lines, and equipment components. The company employs a mixed sales model with distribution channels for CNC machine tools and direct sales for automation lines and components. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance, including installation and commissioning for certain products. Additional income is derived from after-sales services, technical support, and government subsidies related to technology development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international high-end CNC machine tool manufacturers, including established players from Germany, Japan, the USA, and Taiwan. It is recognized as a rapidly growing emerging enterprise in China's intelligent manufacturing equipment sector, with a strong position in mid-to-high-end CNC machine tools and automation solutions. The company has received multiple industry awards and certifications, positioning itself as a leading domestic brand advancing import substitution and technological innovation in the intelligent manufacturing equipment industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.037 billion, a 6.04% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 127.98 million, down 10.3%. Total assets reached RMB 2.15 billion, up 4.52%, and shareholders' equity was RMB 1.63 billion, up 2.72%. R&D investment accounted for 5.2% of revenue. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and has completed share repurchases. It has a stable financial position with steady growth in assets and equity, despite a slight revenue decline due to market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, high speed, high efficiency, and high stability in its CNC machine tools and intelligent automation solutions. It differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies in error control, thermal compensation, and reliable high-performance components, enabling import substitution of key parts. Its vertically integrated manufacturing of precision components ensures quality and cost advantages. The company offers customized, integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions tailored to diverse industry needs, supported by strong after-sales service and a robust innovation ecosystem.
